name: nooblyjs-apps
description: Workspace runner for the NooblyJS applications (blog, cms, wiki)

scripts.install:all: npm run install:blog && npm run install:cms && npm run install:wiki
scripts.install:wiki: npm --prefix nooblyjs-application-wiki install && npm --prefix nooblyjs-application-wiki run install:backend && npm --prefix nooblyjs-application-wiki run install:web
scripts.test: npm run test:cms && npm run test:wiki
